reproduction: From main at 5f7fd82b, import core_shared_row_materializer in an isolated fixture. Supply one valid ETHBTC row among 168 slots, a breadth owner timestamp after the row cutoff, three BTC.D rows in non-chronological order with post-cutoff verification, and a current hourly baseline different from the frozen row baseline. The current gate accepts the first three malformed cases in controlled tests and the outcome owner matures from the later baseline. The production breadth owner additionally fails because membership_hash is nested while the materializer expects it top-level.
stop_condition: Stop without implementation if the research candidate is not CODEX_READY on fresh main, any required fix exceeds allowed_change_scope, or an acceptance test would require changing market rules or thresholds.
